notes: ndless_sdk and arm_gnu_toolchain are build-time dependencies resolved by tools/bootstrap-ndless.sh.

nmarkdown and khicas_cx2 are reference upstreams. No code from either has been copied into this repository yet; see docs/adr/0001-native-ndless-architecture.md for the licensing obligations that attach when it is.

ndless_sdk.role: Build toolchain wrappers, libndls, libsyscalls, crt0/ldscript, genzehn and make-prg.
ndless_sdk.license: MPL-1.1 for libndls, libsyscalls and thirdparty/nspire-io; ndless-sdk/system and ndless-sdk/include are public domain.
ndless_sdk.device_requirement: TI-Nspire CX II CAS, OS 6.4.0.74, Ndless r2022 installed on the calculator.

arm_gnu_toolchain.role: Prebuilt cross compiler for tools/bootstrap-ndless.sh --toolchain=prebuilt. Avoids building GCC, which needs root to install its build dependencies.
arm_gnu_toolchain.why_this_release: ndless-sdk/system/ldscript uses REVERSE(), a linker-script feature added in binutils 2.44. Ndless's own build_toolchain.sh pins binutils 2.44 for the same reason, so any older prebuilt toolchain fails to link with a syntax error on that line.
arm_gnu_toolchain.linked_into_application: Only the newlib C runtime and libgcc.

nmarkdown.role: Reference for the platform adapter, RGB565 renderer, Markdown and math layout.

khicas_cx2.role: Reference Giac build configuration and comparison oracle for scalar results.
